related.title: Unimate 工業機器人工程史
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：功能單位一致、替換件未漏算、所有保留件可追溯，節省數值清楚標為合成情境。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Functional units agree, replacement parts are counted, retained items are traceable, and savings are labeled synthetic.
related.difference: 把搬運循環轉為可驗證的狀態機，辨認吞吐量與等待時間。
related.differenceEn: Convert a transfer cycle into a verifiable state machine and separate throughput from waiting.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 相同功能與壽命前提下，節能比=(Enew−Ereman)/Enew；功能不等效時需要重新正規化。 合成100 kg設備保留75 kg、替換25 kg；新製1000 kWh，再製拆解30、檢查40、加工180、組裝50 kWh，替換件8 kWh/kg。 Ereman=30+40+180+50+25×8=500 kWh；節能50%，材料保留75%。未含運輸及耗材。
串行循環的總時間是各段時間之和；吞吐量以 3600/T 換算每小時件數。；教學時間為取件 2 s、確認 1 s、搬運 3 s、卸件 1 s。；T=2+1+3+1=7 s；q=3600/7=514.286 件/h。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At equivalent function/life, saving fraction=(Enew−Ereman)/Enew; nonequivalent service requires renormalization. Synthetic 100 kg unit retains 75 kg and replaces 25 kg; new 1000 k Wh; reman disassembly 30, inspection 40, rework 180, assembly 50 k Wh; replacement parts 8 k Wh/kg. Ereman=500 k Wh; energy saving 50%, material retention 75%, excluding transport and consumables.
A serial cycle sums segment times; throughput is 3600/T parts per hour.; Teaching times are pickup 2 s, confirmation 1 s, transfer 3 s and release 1 s.; T=2+1+3+1=7 s; q=3600/7=514.286 parts/h.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Epson SCARA 裝配平台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：功能單位一致、替換件未漏算、所有保留件可追溯，節省數值清楚標為合成情境。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Functional units agree, replacement parts are counted, retained items are traceable, and savings are labeled synthetic.
related.difference: 用雅可比行列式辨認伸直附近的運動學敏感性。
related.differenceEn: Use the Jacobian determinant to identify sensitivity near full extension.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 相同功能與壽命前提下，節能比=(Enew−Ereman)/Enew；功能不等效時需要重新正規化。 合成100 kg設備保留75 kg、替換25 kg；新製1000 kWh，再製拆解30、檢查40、加工180、組裝50 kWh，替換件8 kWh/kg。 Ereman=30+40+180+50+25×8=500 kWh；節能50%，材料保留75%。未含運輸及耗材。
二連桿平面部分 detJ=L1L2 sinθ2；接近零表示某方向速度能力退化。；教學 L1=0.25 m、L2=0.20 m，θ2=90°。；detJ=0.25×0.20×sin90°=0.05 m²。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At equivalent function/life, saving fraction=(Enew−Ereman)/Enew; nonequivalent service requires renormalization. Synthetic 100 kg unit retains 75 kg and replaces 25 kg; new 1000 k Wh; reman disassembly 30, inspection 40, rework 180, assembly 50 k Wh; replacement parts 8 k Wh/kg. Ereman=500 k Wh; energy saving 50%, material retention 75%, excluding transport and consumables.
For the two-link planar section, detJ=L1L2 sinθ2; near zero, velocity capability degenerates in one direction.; Teaching L1=0.25 m, L2=0.20 m and θ2=90°.; detJ=0.25×0.20×sin90°=0.05 m².
